title: One dataset, three views
description: the same 12 products as price vs rating, ranked revenue, and revenue share · click to morph between them, each product travelling to its new position

props.name: data
props.description: Stable product IDs and caller-owned names, nullable nonnegative price, satisfaction and revenue in thousands. IDs must be unique; repeated display names remain separate products. Revenue rank assigns a stable tone across all three encodings.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
